name: MirrorAPI-Bench
description:
MirrorAPI-Bench dataset
	

This dataset contains the following resources:

The testing data for MirrorAPI and MirrorAPI-Cache:

test_sft/: The testing data for MirrorAPI with SFT prompts.
test_cot/: The testing data for MirrorAPI with CoT prompts.
reference/: The references for testing data without JSON format. These references are used for evaluation. Note that cache.jsonl has only 200 random samples from test_cache.json.
test_cache.json: The testing data for MirrorAPI-Cache.… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/stabletoolbench/MirrorAPI-Bench.
evaluation_method: exact_match (structured response / JSON matching / task success rate used depending on subtask)
reputation: A recent, niche dataset used within the tool-bench / API-calling evaluation community (limited but growing adoption).
